theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks maintain dominant narrative leadership with broad participation (breadth 0.86) and not crowded; the absolute trend gate is positive, suggesting lower risk of severe drawdown relative to other themes. However, mixed trend health and the rank’s zero predictive power keep conviction low.

falsifier.text: Big Banks lose trend-gate eligibility or durability falls below 0.5 within 20 trading days.

theses.dissent: Supply disruptions in copper or a depreciation of CAD could ignite a fresh leg higher irrespective of breadth; the low durability may repair quickly.

falsifier.text: Base Metals breadth rises above 0.5 and durability exceeds 0.5 within 20 trading days.
